data.title: D · 晨光厨房的围裙咖啡倾注
data.description: 安全屋阳光明媚的开放式厨房内，手冲咖啡的浓郁香气弥漫四溢。D穿着干净利落的纯白棉麻围裙，内穿浅色无袖衫。她正神情专注地提着手冲细嘴壶注水，棕色长发随性束在身后。听见脚步声，冷峻的面部线条瞬间化为柔和的微笑，转过身来将刚冲好的黑咖啡递向你，尽展体贴从容的妻子风范。
data.action: pouring hot water into coffee dripper, wearing white domestic apron over sleeveless top, long brown hair pinned, turning with warm affectionate domestic smile
data.location: modern sunlit open-plan kitchen with wooden breakfast island
data.lighting: pure bright morning sunlight pouring across marble kitchen counter
data.mood: idyllic deceptive domestic peace, quiet sincere matrimonial warmth
data.promptProse: Brewing pour-over coffee in a sunlit modern kitchen, D wears a neat white domestic apron over bare shoulders. Sunbeams catch her brown hair as she looks up with a calm, devoted wife-like smile.
data.animaCaption: D brewing coffee in an apron in a sunny kitchen, looking up with a gentle wifely smile.
